scope: Research only. Do not alter household production data, schedules, simulations, fees, questionnaires or deployment.
target: Compare independent coarse preference clusters with expert-designed EB A-F roles; matching six is not an inclusion or success criterion.

iflex2020.sample: All 800 survey2 respondents; survey1 background linked only by verified unique household ID.
semantics: willingness to act occasionally after advance notification
required saving for a four-hour demand reduction
cautions: Automation investment is not third-party authorization
Daily routine-change willingness is not actual schedule regularity
Aq2 neutral responses have ambiguous English blank encoding and are excluded from primary clustering
sensitivity: compare with 2021 survey3 using common motivation fields only

dutch2025.sample: One valid appliance branch per respondent; require all four core responses. EV/laundry/dishwasher branches are aligned within each real respondent, never joined across independent people.
cautions: Automatic pilot means psychological habit, not external device control
Branch and EV ownership are not clustering inputs
No joint cost-versus-thermal-comfort or authorization measurement

model: Categorical latent class model; preserve original response categories, including explicit don't-know. Complete-case core features only, with exclusions reported.

comparison.selection: minimum BIC; report six regardless of selection
comparison.bootstrap: 20 refits each for selected model and six, 10 initializations; align posteriors; report ARI and share intervals
comparison.held_out: three prespecified 80/20 household splits; compare selected k with six using mean test log likelihood

mapping: Use EB native textual role definitions after independent fit. Report partial and absent matches; do not invent caregiver or third-party consent labels from age/equipment. Do not force a one-to-one mapping or sum unmatched clusters into fabricated six proportions.
proportion_reference: EB 584 assigned role conditions are an experimental-composition reference, not own-preference population ground truth. Sample shares without survey weights cannot establish Chinese household population proportions.
outputs: Aggregate profiles, selection, stability, source hashes, mapping limitations; no raw participant answers or individual cluster assignments in repository.
